Container.Name: infrarust
Container.Overview:
Infrarust Minecraft proxy, preconfigured for MCSM. Listens on 25565 and routes players to the right server container by the domain they connect with, discovering servers from the Docker labels MCSM sets. No per-server config files.
Setup: install the "mcsm" template first (it explains the shared "infrarust" network). Copy config.toml from https://github.com/Niki2k1/mcsm/tree/main/unraid/infrarust into the config folder mapped below before starting. Point a DNS wildcard such as *.mc.example.com at your Unraid IP and forward port 25565.
Container.Requires: The "mcsm" template, the user-defined Docker network "infrarust", and a config.toml in the config folder (sample in the MCSM repo under unraid/infrarust/).

Config.Name: Minecraft port
Config.Description: Port players connect to. Forward it on your router.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Must contain config.toml (see the MCSM repo, unraid/infrarust/config.toml). The servers/ and plugins/ subfolders are created on first start.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Read-only. Infrarust watches container events to discover MCSM servers.
